so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind…
Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.
One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

translations.web: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
translations.bsb: When the crowds saw this, they were filled with awe and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
translations.kjv: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
translations.asv: But when the multitudes saw it, they were afraid, and glorified God, who had given such authority unto men.
